speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: Morning! Have you considered donating to Save the Children? It's a great organization and doesn't cost much to help a child in need.

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: I have not. I am not sure I know what Save the Children is.

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: It's an  international non-governmental organization that promotes children's rights, provides relief and helps support children in developing countries. It has done wonderful things and is a big part of many organizations employee giving drives.

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Oh cool. Do they help people here in the USA?

text: Right now they're concentrating at an international level. Did you know that in the first two months of 2018, over 1,000 children were reportedly killed or injured in Syria alone? They also appeal to stop hunger issues abroad.

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Yes, I know about Syria. I know hunger is a big issue for a lot of people in other countries. Do they provide food for these people?

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: They provide whatever is needed. AND, in relation to the US, they are currently working on the Hurricane Lane situation in Hawaii. They are also big on sending girls to schools in other countries.

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Sounds like they do a lot of different things for people.

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: Yes. it's a great organization. You can find out more if you'd like. I can give you their website. How much would you be willing to donate?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: I am not sure yet. What is their website?

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: URL  Any amount of would be appreciated. They can do a lot of things with your donation.

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: I will look at the website. Is the donation tax deductible?

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: Depending on tax laws in your state, it is. You may need to check with your tax advisor. How about donating to sponsor a child in the US?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: Do I get anything for donating?

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: Other than the satisfaction of helping a child in need?!  You will receive a photo with the child you sponsor and can correspond with them if you choose.  How much would you like to donate?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: The photo would be nice, it would let me know and connect with someone I am helping. How do I know my money goes to the cause and not just to the pockets of the people that run it.

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: This is a great organization with a very stellar reputation. There are FAQs on the website that can address all of those concerns, which I certainly can understand. How about a donation of $25 to start?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: How long has Save the Children been helping people all over the world?

speaker: A10249252O9I20MRSOBVF
text: It varies for different regions of the world. Would you be willing to start your donation today, while we're talking?

speaker: A3IQ7EGSSQF1AA
text: yes I can donate. I don't have much. How about .25?
